prompt: Build a polished Roblox main menu titled AURORA. Features: Play, Settings, Credits. Settings opens a panel with Music on/off toggle and Volume slider. Credits opens a small panel. Both panels have Close. Desktop and mobile. Rich glossy cyan/cobalt artwork with thick navy edges, warm gold highlights, ornamental corner details and a title plate. Use Gemini-generated matching skins and icons: button skins, panel skin, slider track and handle, toggle on/off pieces and distinct play/settings/credits/close icons. Keep text live and readable. Create only these features; no shop, rewards, currency, ranks or invented game systems. Play closes the menu and fires a clearly named local hook for game integration. Coherent hover and press animation. Native background layout with restrained decoration. Panels must open and close in the actual controller.
